products.name: Micron 64 GB DDR5-6400 RDIMM 2Rx4 CL52
products.summary: 64 GB dual-rank x4 DDR5-6400 registered ECC server DIMM (MTC40F2046S1RC64BR) for current Intel Xeon and AMD EPYC platforms.
products.description: This Micron DDR5 RDIMM uses a register chip to buffer command and address signals and on-module ECC to protect data integrity in servers. Micron positions it for virtualization, cloud, databases and other memory-intensive workloads on the latest Intel and AMD server platforms. The module is rated DDR5-6400, CL52, 2Rx4.
products.keywords: server ram ddr5 rdimm ecc registered 64gb 6400 micron mtc40f2046s1rc64br
products.notes: crucial.com lists this Micron module as in stock but shows no public price (2026-09-28); USD price is a TrustKart estimate reflecting 2026 DRAM pricing.
